hooks.command: wally_repo_root="$(python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path.cwd().resolve(); cands=list(dict.fromkeys([p, *p.parents, *sorted(c for c in p.iterdir() if c.is_dir())])); print(next(str(d) for d in cands if (d/".wally/scripts/sop_context.py").is_file()))')" || exit 0; python3 "$wally_repo_root/.wally/scripts/sop_context.py" --repo "$wally_repo_root" --hook --client claude --event UserPromptSubmit # wally:sop_context:UserPromptSubmit

wally_repo_root="$(python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path.cwd().resolve(); cands=list(dict.fromkeys([p, *p.parents, *sorted(c for c in p.iterdir() if c.is_dir())])); print(next(str(d) for d in cands if (d/".wally/scripts/sop_context.py").is_file()))')" || exit 0; python3 "$wally_repo_root/.wally/scripts/sop_context.py" --repo "$wally_repo_root" --hook --client claude --event PreToolUse # wally:sop_context:PreToolUse
